description: This Java class 'Variant' provides methods for handling variant data types, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion. It manages different data types like boolean, long, double, decimal, string, date, timestamp, binary, UUID, and complex object/array structures within a variant data format. The class interacts with utility functions from 'VariantUtil' and handles internal binary representations of variant data.

classes.name: Variant
classes.description: Main class for handling variant data types, including serialization, deserialization, and JSON conversion. Supports various data types and complex structures like objects and arrays.

classes.name: Variant.ObjectField
classes.description: Represents a key-value pair within a Variant object, holding a string key and a Variant value.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the byte array representing the variant's value, possibly a subrange based on 'pos'.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata byte array associated with the variant.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value from the variant data.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieves a long integer value from the variant data.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double-precision floating point value from the variant data.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal value from the variant data.

methods.name: getDecimalWithOriginalScale
methods.description: Retrieves a BigDecimal including trailing zeros.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Retrieves a float value from the variant data.

methods.name: getBinary
methods.description: Retrieves binary data as a byte array.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the variant data.

methods.name: getTypeInfo
methods.description: Returns type information bits from the variant.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the variant.

methods.name: getUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a UUID value from the variant data.

methods.name: objectSize
methods.description: Returns the number of object fields; valid only if type is OBJECT.

methods.name: getFieldByKey
methods.description: Finds and returns a field by key within an object variant.

methods.name: getFieldAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the object field at a specific index.

methods.name: getDictionaryIdAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the dictionary ID for a specific object field index.

methods.name: arraySize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in an array variant.

methods.name: getElementAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the array element at a specific index.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the variant to a JSON string, using specified timezone.

methods.name: escapeJson
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for JSON formatting.

methods.name: appendQuoted
methods.description: Appends a quoted string to a StringBuilder.

methods.name: toJsonImpl
methods.description: Internal method to convert variant data to JSON format recursively.
